_comment: Scenario registry: driver file scenarios/<name>.luau, the schema (per-library definitions live in adapters/<adapter>/), whether it only exists in blink-plus, and frames_scale, a multiplier on --frames so cheap scenarios run long enough for stable timings.

scenarios.name: match_state_reliable
scenarios.desc: server FireAll 22-player match snapshot to 44 clients, Reliable, ManyAsync

scenarios.name: match_state_unreliable
scenarios.desc: server FireAll 22-player match snapshot to 44 clients, Unreliable, SingleSync

scenarios.name: per_player
scenarios.desc: server Fire(player) 5 small reliable events to each of 44 players

scenarios.name: client_input
scenarios.desc: 44 clients fire Unreliable input every frame + Reliable action every 4th

scenarios.name: many_events
scenarios.desc: 120 declared events, 24 fired per frame (FireAll) across the index range

scenarios.name: burst_async
scenarios.desc: 1 client receives 200 events in one frame, ManyAsync listener

scenarios.name: burst_sync
scenarios.desc: 1 client receives 200 events in one frame, SingleSync listener

scenarios.name: two_way
scenarios.desc: From: Both event, server FireAll + every client Fire on the same event
